records.name: CASCADE
records.demonstrated_target: Li_xCoO2 battery cathode crystals and MLIP density/volume comparisons
records.boundary_conditions: crystalline materials; explicit PBC wording not separately audited

sources.locator: Section 2.3, Collaborative research with memory; Fig. 5; Appendix B.3
sources.evidence_paraphrase: In human-agent exchanges, the system selects MLIPs, executes structural relaxations and energy calculations, and obtains lithium-intercalation voltages. Separate wet-lab and database-only cases do not determine inclusion.

records.limitations: Only the inspected crystalline simulation case determines the target class and task marks. Molecular QC questions listed in SciSkillBench are not by themselves treated as demonstrated additional targets. Human guidance is retained. SkillPuzzler is a related earlier title, not counted again. The earlier SkillPuzzler workshop predecessor predates 29 December; this dated field identifies the verified CASCADE-title preprint, not a secure family-first appearance.
records.date_basis: verified CASCADE-title arXiv date; predecessor posting date unresolved

records.name: FermiLink
records.demonstrated_target: finite molecular electronic structure and biomolecular/soft-matter MD; additional materials simulations
records.boundary_conditions: multiple packages and models; no single boundary condition assigned

sources.locator: Sections II.1–II.2; Table S1 Chemistry and Molecular Science (GROMACS, LAMMPS, Psi4, PySCF); Table S2 CP2K
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Codex-driven workflows rerun molecular electronic-structure and molecular-dynamics packages. The paper distinguishes newly executed simulations from merely replotted figures; only executed cases support these marks.

records.limitations: General scientific infrastructure; non-atomistic physics and engineering tasks are not counted as chemistry evidence. Replotted and blocked tasks are not simulation successes. T/O/F/R remain unencoded without case-level evidence in this pass.

records.name: AtomisticSkills
records.demonstrated_target: solid electrolytes, MOFs, catalyst surfaces and protein–ligand complexes
records.boundary_conditions: crystal and surface cells plus explicit-water biomolecular MD; not a single PBC class

sources.evidence_paraphrase: Coding agents construct and relax solids, submit DFT energies/forces, sample configurations by MD, and execute explicit-water MD refinement of docked protein–ligand complexes.

records.limitations: A skills/tool harness for general coding agents. Human review of campaign plans is retained. Drug docking alone does not establish inclusion; the executed downstream MD does. MD-derived binding free energies are under D, not vibrational F.

records.name: SQD-Agent
records.demonstrated_target: small-molecule ground-state energies including N2 and CH2O

sources.locator: Section I Figs. 1–5; Section II Discussions and Future Scope
sources.evidence_paraphrase: An LLM orchestration layer generates and executes molecular SQD electronic-structure workflows on classical simulators and a quantum processor, with explicit human confirmation before hardware submission.

records.limitations: Proof of concept in a minimal basis; the authors explicitly describe human-supervised reconfiguration and no autonomous closed feedback loop. Inclusion does not imply full autonomy or quantum advantage.

records.name: Magnolia
records.demonstrated_target: aromatic molecules, gas-phase butane and modified DNA
records.boundary_conditions: finite molecular QC/gas-phase dynamics and solvated DNA cells

sources.evidence_paraphrase: The agent generates and optimizes aromatic structures, evaluates electronic properties, runs butane dynamics and a relaxed torsion scan, and constructs and tracks modified-DNA MD campaigns.

records.limitations: Human-reviewed memory and scientific decisions remain explicit. A torsional scan is not coded as a TS/IRC proof. Docking claims and proprietary targets do not determine task marks.

screening.name: CatGo
screening.reason: Official repository https://github.com/Hello-QM/catgo-LRG and author CP2K announcement confirm geometry tools, an agent-driven DAG workflow executor and QC/MD integrations. Publisher HTML/PDF and ChemRxiv 10.26434/chemrxiv.15002984/v1 were inaccessible in this pass; keep implemented support distinct from inspected executed case evidence. Important architectural neighbour requiring full-paper review, not an absence-of-capability claim.
screening.locator: Official README, Releases v1.4.14, CP2K discussion 5221; paper DOI

screening.name: Mimosa
screening.reason: Original report evaluates ScienceAgentBench data-driven research tasks and workflow evolution. This pass did not establish an agent-executed molecular/atomistic calculation case; generic simulation language or computational-chemistry dataset labels do not suffice for the main denominator.

screening.name: Science Done on a Machine by a Machine
screening.reason: Perspective and Table 1 provide a major citation-chain seed list of 49 systems. It is a discovery source, not another system, and its capability coding and denominator are not copied into the present dataset.
